=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:441-497 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_asf_compose_body`, clean() rewrites only the `#<digit>` form (`re.sub(r"#(?=[0-9])", "# ", text)`, line 446), so URL-form closing references such as `fixes https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/N` pass through it. The new as_text() renders that model-written decision text into the Auto-decisions table (line 497) outside any code fence. glm adds that the fenced `summary`/`proposed_fix` text becomes the squash commit message, and asf_publish() runs the lint with only `--pr-body-file`.
  WHY: scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py recognises the URL form (lines 79-84) but blocks only issues labelled `ai:orchestrator-tracking` (line 280), and scripts/alert_triage.py `_clean` (lines 576-582) strips only control characters, so the auto-merged (`gh pr merge --auto --squash`) self-fix PR can silently close an unrelated issue. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 raised the same issue only as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION. Suggested fix: add `text = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(https?):/{2}", r"\1:/ /", text)` after line 446.
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:asf_publish() | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: asf_ledger_put() creates and pushes the ledger record (self_fix/pr-<n>.json) before `gh pr merge` runs.
  WHY: If the merge fails, the record stays behind for an unmerged PR, and scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh relies on that record to prove ownership, so it might process a broken-state PR. Source severity was MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this and rejected it as deliberate ordering.
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:asf_prepare() | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The git worktree created for the fix is not explicitly cleaned up on every exit path or when the self-fix completes.
  WHY: A failed or interrupted workflow can leave the directory under RUNNER_TEMP behind, and that could interfere with later runs. Source severity was NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it: the runner is ephemeral, asf_prepare runs `rm -rf` before `worktree add`, and the branch name contains the unique run_id.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "PR body: use `Refs #<tracking>`, never auto-close keywords for the tracking issue."
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh, _asf_compose_body() (lines ~441-500), plus the full-flow assertions in tests/test_alert_self_fix.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The composed body emits only `Refs:` lines for workflow-run URLs and run_re-filtered evidence URLs (`refs = [run_url] + [...]`, lines 464-500) and has no `Refs #9394` entry. `test_full_self_fix_opens_labelled_pr_with_automerge_and_ledger` at tests/test_alert_self_fix.py:230-231 asserts the run URL refs but not the tracking reference. The agents.d fragment says "`Refs:` run URLs only". Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR, gpt-6-luna and glm rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected the gap: it reads the constraint as covering only the implementation PR, whose body contains `Refs #9394`.
- requirement: "The full test suite passes on the head SHA in a credential-free job." (Condition 5 of the break-glass scan)
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh, abg_test() (condition 5)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: abg_test() selects only top-level tests/test_*.py files and passes them to the tests-only gate. It does not run the Vitest suite in tools/claude-pool-broker/, which .github/workflows/ci.yml runs with `npx vitest run`. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it because `tools/**` is in break_glass_denied_paths (.github/ai/alert_inbox.json).
- requirement: "Run the affected tests ... and the static checks that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs."
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh, asf_verify()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: asf_verify() parses syntax and calls the pre-push gate, which runs Ruff and ShellCheck on changed Python and shell files. It does not run CI's `actionlint` check for workflow changes or the other static-check steps in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Source severity was NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:_asf_compose_body — clean() lines 441-449 (line 446), as_text() line 451, Auto-decisions row line 497 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: scripts/alert_triage.py (lines 625-629) emits decisions as `{question, chosen, reason}`, and its `_clean` (lines 576-582) strips only control characters. as_text() now renders that text into the Auto-decisions table outside a code fence, and clean() breaks only the `#N` form, so a URL-form closing reference (`fixes https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/N`) passes through.
  WHY: scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py recognises the URL form (AUTO_CLOSE_RE, lines 79-84) but blocks only `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issues. asf_publish enables `gh pr merge --auto --squash`, so the merge silently closes an unrelated issue (e.g. #1234). The comment in clean() saying the text "cannot auto-close" is false for this path. Fix: `text = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(https?):/{2}", r"\1:/ /", text)`.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh _asf_compose_body, clean(), after line 446. Same URL-form fix, 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Notes (checked, not adopted, 4 related items): worktree cleanup in asf_prepare (RUNNER_TEMP is ephemeral, `rm -rf` runs before `worktree add`, the branch name has a unique run_id); ledger record written before `gh pr merge` (deliberate ownership proof, break-glass re-checks only open PRs); Vitest not run by condition 5 (`tools/**` is in break_glass_denied_paths); `Refs #<tracking>` missing (the constraint covers the implementation PR's body, which has `Refs #9394`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
